meta.title: EcoAgta EZ3+ Multi-Crop Concentrate — Triple Acting Organic Input
meta.description: EcoAgta EZ3+ helps control and deter whiteflies and helps prevent sooty mold fungus, while promoting healthier growth. Non-toxic, readily biodegradable green chemistry.

ez3plus.name: EcoAgta EZ3+ Multi-Crop Concentrate
ez3plus.tagline: One spray. Three actions. Up to six months of protection.
ez3plus.intro: EZ3+ is CraftDyne's flagship green-chemistry farm input. It addresses whiteflies and sooty mold while supporting the plant's growth and immunity from a single application.

whiteflies.title: Helps control and deter whiteflies
whiteflies.description: Acts on the pest that drives both direct feeding damage and honeydew production.

sootyMold.title: Helps prevent sooty mold fungus
sootyMold.description: Interrupts the cycle where honeydew deposits become a black fungal film blocking photosynthesis.

growth.title: Promotes healthier plant growth
growth.description: Supports vigour and canopy development through the protected period.

productivity.title: Supports higher crop productivity
productivity.description: Healthier plants hold yield potential throughout the growing season.

safety.title: 100% Non-toxic & Biodegradable
safety.description: Zero harm to air, water, soil, and the food chain.

howItWorks.heading: How the triple action works
howItWorks.description: Whitefly damage causes feeding stress and honeydew deposits that cultivate sooty mold. EZ3+ targets all three stages simultaneously.

deter.title: Deter the pest
deter.description: Repels whiteflies, aphids, mealybugs, and larvae to prevent heavy infestations.

prevent.title: Prevent secondary infection
prevent.description: Inhibits sooty mold fungus from colonising leaf surfaces.

promote.title: Promote plant vigour
promote.description: Boosts chlorophyll efficiency, photosynthesis, and natural systemic immunity.

targets.label: Primary targets
targets.value: Whiteflies, aphids, mealybugs, sooty mold fungus

crops.label: Suitable for
crops.value: Vegetable, fruit, plantation and commercial crops

foodChain.label: Food chain
foodChain.value: No harm to the food chain

residue.label: Air, water and soil
residue.value: Zero harm to air, water or soil

application.heading: Using EZ3+
application.description: EZ3+ is applied as a foliar spray using standard spraying equipment.
application.notice: Recommended dosage varies with crop and pest pressure. Spray in early morning or late afternoon for best results.

howLong.question: How long does one application last?
howLong.answer: A single application can provide up to six months of protection under standard conditions.

organic.question: Is EZ3+ suitable for organic farming?
organic.answer: Yes, EZ3+ is formulated according to IUPAC Green Chemistry principles using 100% readily biodegradable organic inputs.

safety.question: Is it safe around farm workers and animals?
safety.answer: Yes, EZ3+ is non-poisonous, non-fuming, and non-irritating.

crops.question: Which crops can it be used on?
crops.answer: Suitable for vegetables, fruits, commercial crops, and tree plantations.

mixing.question: Can it be tank-mixed?
mixing.answer: Check with our technical team before tank-mixing with chemical inputs.

buy.question: How do I purchase or become a distributor?
buy.answer: Contact our sales team directly via WhatsApp, phone, or the enquiry form.

cta.title: Interested in EZ3+ for your crop?
cta.description: Contact our technical team for custom dosage and application schedules.

meta.title: EcoAgta EZ3+ Concentrate for Coconut Trees — Whitefly & Sooty Mold Control
meta.description: Targeted organic treatment for Coconut Palms against Rugose Spiraling Whitefly (RSW), sooty mold fungus, and sap-sucking insects. Long-lasting protection.

ez3Coconut.name: EcoAgta EZ3+ Concentrate for Coconut Trees
ez3Coconut.tagline: Eradicates Rugose Spiraling Whitefly & Sooty Mold on Coconut Canopies.
ez3Coconut.intro: EcoAgta EZ3+ Coconut Formula provides fast-acting and lasting protection against Rugose Spiraling Whitefly (RSW Aleurodicus rugioperculatus) and the resulting Sooty Mold Fungus (Capnodium) on coconut trees.

rsw.title: Controls Rugose Spiraling Whitefly
rsw.description: Effectively repels and deters RSW, aphids, soft scales, and felt scales on coconut fronds.

sooty.title: Eradicates Sooty Mold Fungus
sooty.description: Clears black sooty mold film from fronds, restoring light absorption and photosynthesis within weeks.

stress.title: Reduces Shade & Canopy Stress
stress.description: Boosts photosynthesis in shaded canopy areas and improves overall palm vigour.

pathogens.title: Prevents Secondary Diseases
pathogens.description: Interrupts insect-vectored diseases such as Phytophthora and Fusarium.

safety.title: Zero Environmental Harm
safety.description: Safe for soil earthworms, surrounding livestock, and natural water bodies.

dilution.heading: Dilution & Spray Directions
dilution.description: Use clean, fresh stream or well water (non-chlorinated preferred). Mix thoroughly for 10 minutes.
dilution.timing: Spray between 6:00 AM - 10:30 AM or 3:30 PM - 6:30 PM. Ensure full canopy coverage.

rswControl.question: Does EZ3+ control Rugose Spiraling Whitefly (RSW)?
rswControl.answer: Yes! EZ3+ specifically deters RSW adult feeding and egg laying while clearing sooty mold fungus.

dosage.question: What is the dosage for Coconut trees?
dosage.answer: Use a starting dose of 1:300 for initial treatment, followed by 1:400 for maintenance sprays.

frequency.question: How often should I spray coconut trees?
frequency.answer: Typically 2 to 3 sprays per year maintain a clear frond canopy and high nut yields.

safety.question: Is it safe for beneficial insects?
safety.answer: Yes, EZ3+ works via physical and repellent mechanisms without broad-spectrum chemical toxicity.

water.question: What water should be used for dilution?
water.answer: Fresh well or stream water is recommended. Avoid chlorinated tap water where possible.

meta.title: EcoAgta EZ3+ Cardamom Crop Treatment — Insect & Disease Shield
meta.description: Recommended organic treatment for Cardamom plantations. Protects against thrips, aphids, whiteflies, mosaic virus vector, and soil nematodes.

ez3Cardamom.name: EcoAgta EZ3+ Cardamom Crop Treatment
ez3Cardamom.tagline: Protects Cardamom plantations from Thrips, Aphids & Virus Vectors.
ez3Cardamom.intro: EZ3+ Cardamom Crop Treatment offers targeted protection against destructive sap-sucking insects in Cardamom plantations including Thrips, Aphids, Mealybugs, Spider Mites, and Banana Aphids (vector for Mosaic Virus).

suckers.title: Controls Sap-Sucking Pests
suckers.description: Repels Thrips, Aphids, Mealybugs, Soft Scales, and Spider Mites.

virus.title: Prevents Virus Transmission
virus.description: Prevents Mosaic Virus by controlling vector insects such as Pentalonia nigronervosa.

nematodes.title: Deters Soil Nematodes
nematodes.description: Helps suppress harmful nematode populations around Cardamom root zones.

photosynthesis.title: Enhances Canopy Photosynthesis
photosynthesis.description: Improves plant chlorophyll activity in shaded hill-slopes and under tree shade.

biodegradable.title: 100% Readily Biodegradable
biodegradable.description: Leaves no chemical residues on harvested cardamom pods.

dilution.heading: Dosage & Application Instructions
dilution.description: Dilute with fresh non-chlorinated well or stream water.
dilution.timing: Apply symptomatically when insects are spotted. Spray 3 times per growing season.

thrips.question: Does EZ3+ control Cardamom Thrips?
thrips.answer: Yes, EZ3+ repels thrips and prevents feeding damage on cardamom shoots and pods.

dosage.question: What is the recommended dilution ratio for Cardamom?
dosage.answer: Dilute 1:400 in fresh water (e.g. 250 mL in 100 Liters of water).

combination.question: Can it be combined with Myco Spectra?
combination.answer: Yes! EZ3+ handles insect pests while Myco Spectra controls cardamom fungal diseases like Phytophthora and Pythium.

residue.question: Will EZ3+ affect the flavor or aroma of Cardamom pods?
residue.answer: No. EZ3+ is completely organic and readily biodegradable, leaving zero chemical residue.

safety.question: Is it safe for hill-station ecosystems?
safety.answer: Yes, zero harm to mountain streams, soil micro-fauna, or wildlife.

meta.title: EcoAgta Blumenn Strong Super Concentrate — Premature Fruit Drop Prevention
meta.description: Blumenn Strong Super Concentrate prevents premature fruit drop, increases yield, and provides systemic protection & insect repellency.

blumennStrong.name: EcoAgta Blumenn Strong Super Concentrate
blumennStrong.kicker: For Preventing Premature Fruit Drop & Increasing Yield
blumennStrong.tagline: Systemic Protection, Immunity & Yield Enhancement for Fruit & Plantation Crops.
blumennStrong.intro: EcoAgta Blumenn Strong Super Concentrate addresses both internal physiological stress and external pest pressures that cause premature fruit drop in guava, mango, citrus, coconut, and tapioca.

drop.title: Prevents Premature Fruit Drop
drop.description: Prevents abscission layer formation and ovule degeneration to retain viable fruit.

yield.title: Increases Farm Yield & Savings
yield.description: Boosts usable harvest yields and saves farming input costs over long protection periods.

immunity.title: Provides Systemic Immunity
immunity.description: Strengthens internal plant immunity against Powdery Mildew, Anthracnose, and rot.

decay.title: Repels Sap-Sucking Insects
decay.description: Deters Leaf Hoppers and Mealybugs from infesting fruit clusters.

safety.title: 100% Non-toxic & Safe
safety.description: Zero harm to air, water, soil, applicators, or the food chain.

causes.heading: Underlying Causes Addressed
causes.sub: Blumenn Strong tackles physiological causes and pest pressures simultaneously.

dilution.heading: Dilution & Spray Recommendations
dilution.description: Follow dilution guidelines using clean fresh well or stream water.
dilution.ratioTitle: Dilution Ratio for Tree & Plantation Crops
dilution.waterType: Mix thoroughly for 10 minutes in a clean mixing drum.

usage.timingBody: Spray from 6:00 AM to 10:30 AM or 3:30 PM to 6:30 PM.
usage.coverage: Ensure thorough coverage on all leaves and developing fruitlets.

safety.heading: Safety & Eco-Compatibility
safety.notice: Non-poisonous, non-fuming, non-irritating to applicators and animals.

purpose.question: What is the main purpose of Blumenn Strong?
purpose.answer: Blumenn Strong prevents premature fruit drop and increases harvest yields across tree and plantation crops.

crops.question: Which crops benefit most?
crops.answer: Guava, Mango, Coconut, Lemon, Lime, Orange, and Tapioca.

dilution.question: What is the dilution ratio?
dilution.answer: Dilute 1:2000 in fresh water (100 mL in 200 Liters of water).

safety.question: Is it safe for wildlife and water bodies?
safety.answer: Yes, 100% readily biodegradable with zero environmental toxicity.

meta.title: EcoAgta Myco Spectra Fungicide — Broad-Spectrum Organic Pathogen Control
meta.description: Organic broad-spectrum fungicide engineered for Cardamom, plantation, and horticulture crops. Controls Colletotrichum, Phytophthora, Pythium, Alternaria, and Root Rot.

mycoSpectra.name: EcoAgta Myco Spectra Fungicide
mycoSpectra.tagline: Up to 6 months systemic protection against major plant fungi.
mycoSpectra.intro: EcoAgta Myco Spectra is an advanced organic fungicide formulated to suppress and prevent common destructive agricultural fungi. It provides bioavailable plant nutrition and systemic protection for up to 6 months.

fungiControl.title: Controls Major Fungal Pathogens
fungiControl.description: Suppresses Colletotrichum, Phytophthora, Pythium, Phyllosticta elettariae, Alternaria, and Root Rot.

duration.title: Up to 6 Months Protection
duration.description: Provides long-lasting systemic immunity against repeat fungal blights.

bioavailable.title: Bioavailable Plant Nutrition
bioavailable.description: Delivers essential bioavailable nutrients that strengthen cell wall resistance.

yieldSupport.title: Prevents Crop & Pod Loss
yieldSupport.description: Protects Cardamom capsules, fruits, and roots from fungal decay.

greenSafety.title: 100% Eco-Safe Formulation
greenSafety.description: Zero chemical residues, non-toxic, and safe for soil microorganisms.

dilution.heading: Dosage & Application
dilution.directions: Mix thoroughly in clean well or stream water. Spray symptomatically at first sign of fungal spots or preventatively during high-humidity seasons.

fungi.question: Which fungal diseases does Myco Spectra control?
fungi.answer: It controls Colletotrichum, Phytophthora, Pythium, Phyllosticta elettariae, Alternaria, and Root Rot.

cardamom.question: Is Myco Spectra effective on Cardamom plantations?
cardamom.answer: Yes, it is specifically recommended for Cardamom to prevent Capsule Rot, Clump Rot, and Leaf Blight.

dilution.question: What is the recommended dosage?
dilution.answer: Use a 1:400 dilution ratio in fresh water for both starting and continuing sprays.

mixing.question: Can it be applied together with EZ3+?
mixing.answer: Yes, combining EZ3+ and Myco Spectra provides complete dual protection against both insects and fungal diseases.

meta.title: CraftDyne Soil Amend (EcoPop) — Organic Plant-Based Soil Conditioner
meta.description: Pure organic plant-based soil amendment block. High Carbon-to-Nitrogen ratio with Terpenoid and Limonoid content for water retention, aeration, and nematode protection.

soilAmend.name: CraftDyne Soil Amend (EcoPop)
soilAmend.tagline: High Terpenoid & Limonoid content for soil health, root oxygenation & water retention.
soilAmend.intro: CraftDyne Soil Amend (EcoPop) is a 100% plant-based organic soil conditioner compressed into 5kg blocks. It features a high Carbon-to-Nitrogen ratio, rich Terpenoid & Limonoid content, and essential micro-nutrients to rebuild depleted agricultural soils.

porosity.title: Excellent Air Porosity & Water Retention
porosity.description: Retains 14 to 15 Liters of water per kg while maintaining root aeration in heavy soils.

nematode.title: Deters Soil-Borne Nematodes
nematode.description: Naturally resistant to bacteria and fungi, effectively preventing root-knot nematodes.

durability.title: Serves for up to 4 Years
durability.description: Provides long-term soil structure improvement and boosts earthworm activity.

cec.title: High Cation Exchange Capacity
cec.description: Bonds fertilizer ions and releases plant nutrients gradually as demanded by roots.

usda.title: USDA NOP Compliant
usda.description: Permitted under USDA Title 7 CFR 205.203.C3 for organic crop fertilizer and soil amendment.

specs.heading: Technical Specifications
specs.dimensions: 30 cm x 30 cm x 10 cm block
specs.particle: All particles pass 6 mm Mesh (Fines removed)

usage.heading: Usage & Hydration Instructions
usage.hydration: Hydrate the block with fresh water to expand and break it apart into loose organic material.
usage.nursery: Seeds or seedlings may be directly planted into pure Soil Amend or blended into potting soil.
usage.field: Till and mix hydrated Soil Amend blocks into plant beds, field rows, or mound root spread areas.

water.question: How much water does one 5kg block retain?
water.answer: One 5kg block holds between 70 to 75 Liters of water, releasing it slowly to plant roots.

duration.question: How long does Soil Amend last in the soil?
duration.answer: A single application continues to improve soil porosity and nutrient retention for up to 4 years.

nematodes.question: How does it protect against nematodes?
nematodes.answer: Its natural Limonoid and Terpenoid content creates an inhospitable environment for parasitic soil nematodes.

organic.question: Is it certified organic?
organic.answer: Yes, CraftDyne Soil Amend is permitted per USDA NOP rule Title 7 CFR 205.203.C3 as crop fertilizer & soil amendment.
